pages.text: You will only find the $(item)Incomplete Soul Chestplate$() in Ancient City chests. Don't bother looking for the other pieces — they don't have incomplete versions.$(br2)Instead, when the chestplate finishes forging, all $(thing)iron armor$() you are currently wearing will be instantly converted into the corresponding $(thing)soul armor$() pieces.
Missed a piece? Don't worry — while wearing a completed soul chestplate, absorbing a Warden's sonic attack will convert one piece of iron armor on you into soul armor.
